title: Sizzling Beef Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with beef and Peruvian-inspired spices. Serve hot and enjoy!
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from wok and set aside.
Add onion and bell pepper to the wok and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Return beef to the wok and stir in Peruvian stir fry seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Serve hot over rice or noodles, garnished with cilantro if desired.
